lines.en: What time is it now?
It is nine. Look at the clock.
What will we do today?
We will go to the market this afternoon.
Good. Yesterday we stayed home all day.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 어제는 하루 종일 집에 있었어요.

lines.en: Yes. Today is a busy day.
Do we have time for a walk this evening?
Yes, we have one hour after dinner.
lines.ko: 네, 저녁 식사 후에 한 시간 있어요.

lines.en: Please wake me in ten minutes.
Sure. Tomorrow we will rest.
Hello! Can we meet tomorrow?
Yes. What time is good for you?
Is two in the afternoon fine?
I have a class at two. How about the evening?
lines.ko: 두 시에는 수업이 있어요. 저녁은 어때요?

lines.en: Six in the evening is good.
Great. Last week we met at the park.
Let's meet there again. It is a nice place.
I will bring some tea.
Thank you. Don't be late! Watch the clock.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 늦지 마세요! 시계를 잘 봐요.

lines.en: I will be there ten minutes early.
